full_prompt_en: A square figurative painting arranges a family-like group in two close rows before a muted olive background. Three people stand behind and two sit in front. At the upper left, a tall man in a dark green coat and small black hat has a long white beard. Beside him, another man with pale side hair and a large curled mustache wears a black jacket and bow tie. At the upper right, a woman in a high-necked green dress has dark red hair gathered into two round side buns. In front, an older seated man wears spectacles, a broad pale mustache and a mustard vest beneath a dark coat. Next to him, a younger woman folds her hands over a red skirt. Her hair rises into two exaggerated round puffs, and a small white bird perches near her shoulder. A pale orange cat peeks between the two seated figures. All face outward with tiny, steady eyes and restrained expressions. Bodies and heads are unusually full and rounded, while hands and features remain compact. A shallow ornamental arch frames the group with small curled patterns in its upper corners. The clothing forms large, simple dark and earthy color masses, relieved by pale skin, white hair and the small animals. Light is soft and even, with gentle shadow below chins and between overlapping figures. The paint surface is smooth and matte with delicate texture at the edges of garments. The composition is frontal and tightly stacked, almost filling the frame from side to side. Its calm symmetry and exaggerated volumes make the ordinary group portrait feel quietly humorous and ceremonial.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形人物画把近似家庭的一组人分成紧密两排，置于低饱和橄榄色背景前。后排三人站立，前排两人坐着。左上方，一位穿深绿外套、戴小黑帽的高个男人留着长白胡子。旁边另一位男人两侧头发浅白，卷翘大胡子，穿黑上衣和领结。右上方，一位穿高领绿衣的女子把深红头发扎成两侧圆髻。前排一位年长坐姿男人戴眼镜、留宽浅色胡子，深外套下是芥黄色背心。旁边较年轻女子把双手合放在红裙上，头发隆成两个夸张圆团，肩旁停着一只小白鸟。两名坐者之间露出一只浅橙色猫。所有人都以细小稳定的眼睛面向画外，表情克制。身体和头部异常丰满圆厚，手与五官却紧凑。浅浅的装饰拱框圈住这组人，上方两角有小卷纹。衣服形成大而简单的深色、土色色块，被浅色皮肤、白发和小动物提亮。光柔和均匀，在下巴下方和重叠人物之间留有轻影。画面表面平顺哑光，衣缘有细微肌理。构图正面而层层紧叠，几乎从一侧填满至另一侧。平静的对称和夸张体积让寻常合影显得安静幽默，又带一点仪式感。
style_prompt_en: The image has a smooth matte painting surface with softly blended volume and sparing fine texture at edges. Muted olive, deep green, black, mustard and brick red form broad, stable color masses, punctuated by small pale highlights. Shapes are enlarged and rounded, with compact features and simplified hands; their gentle exaggeration creates a distinctive calm rhythm. Frontality and close stacking compress space, so overlapping contours matter more than perspective. Edges are firm enough to separate adjacent masses but rarely sharp or brittle. Soft even light produces shallow shading under curves and within overlaps, without strong cast shadows. A restrained ornamental frame gives the arrangement a formal boundary while leaving the background largely flat. Large bodies and small details coexist in a balanced grid of vertical and circular forms. The overall effect is still, orderly and faintly comic, grounded in measured color areas and unusually generous volumes.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有平顺哑光的绘画表面，体积柔和晕合，边缘只留少量细微肌理。低饱和橄榄色、深绿、黑色、芥黄和砖红组成宽阔稳定的色块，少量浅亮点穿插其中。形状被放大且圆厚，五官与手则紧凑简化；温和夸张形成独特的平静节奏。正面性与紧密堆叠压缩空间，因此遮挡轮廓比透视更重要。边缘足以分开相邻团块，却很少锐利脆硬。柔而均匀的光在曲面下方和形体重叠处产生浅阴影，没有强投影。克制的装饰框为布局划定正式边界，背景仍大体平坦。大体积和小细节共存在竖线与圆形构成的平衡网格中。整体效果静止、有序且微带诙谐，依靠有度的色彩面积和格外丰厚的体积站稳。
theme_en: Five broad, solemn family members pose with a cat and a small white bird before an olive decorative arch
theme_zh: 五位体态圆厚、神情庄重的家人带着猫和白色小鸟，站在橄榄色装饰拱框前
name: Fernando Botero
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
